svg.aria-label: Django, about 54,000 nodes. Shorter is faster. Code-only extract: Graphicle (pre-release build), 7.5 seconds; Graphify 0.9.77, 72.8 seconds. Update after one added definition: Graphicle (pre-release build), 9.8 seconds; Graphify 0.9.77, 107.9 seconds. Medians of five alternating runs, start-up included, one shared Linux host, 8 workers, 8 October 2026. Both built the same graph. The released engine has no published timing yet.
